pages.text: Geely Global You need to enable JavaScript to run this app. home Models Discover Geely About Us Our Brand News & Events News Global User Trip 2024 Our Network Geely Care+ Digital Showroom Geely EX5 Geely EX5 EM-i Geely EX2 Coolray Contact Us SUV SEDAN NEV Discover More Discover More Discover More Discover More Discover More DISCOVER GEELY Geely Auto Group is a leading automobile manufacturer based in Hangzhou, China and was founded in 1997 as a subsidiary unit of Zhejiang Geely Holding Group (ZGH). The Group manages several leading brands, including Geely Auto, Lynk & Co, and Zeekr. Learn More GEELY NEWS Geely Unveils Full-Domain AI 2.0 Vision at Auto China 2026 Showcasing Geely Galaxy Light, Lynk & Co GT Vision, Zeekr hyper-SUVs, and the production-ready Eva Cab robotaxi prototype to 1000+ global partners Geely Auto Group Announced Changes to Its European Executive Structure Geely Auto Group announced two new appointments to the executive structure of Geely Auto Europe effective April 18, 2026. Geely E5 and Starray EM-i Debut in Five European Countries, Marking a Strategic Milestone in Global Expansion Geely Auto has completed its brand rollout across five core European countries – Spain, Germany, the Netherlands, Belgium, and Luxembourg – within a 48-hour window from March 25 to 26. Geely Auto Becomes the First and Only Chinese Automaker Named to S&P Global Sustainability Yearbook 2026, Honored as “Industry Mover” Geely Automobile Holdings Limited was recognized for its outstanding performance in Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG), achieving a significant leap forward in S&P Global’s Corporate Sustainability Assessment (CSA). Geely Auto Leads China's Auto Market for Two Consecutive Months, Achieves Robust Growth at Home and Abroad in February On March 1, Geely Auto released its latest sales figures: passenger vehicle global sales reached 206,160 units in February, maintaining year-on-year growth for two consecutive months at the start of the year. Geely EX2 Named 2025 World No.1 Selling Car in Its Segment and China's No.1 Selling Car Across All Segments The Geely EX2, a pure electric hatchback under the Geely brand, earned the title of World No.1 selling car in A/B segments and China’s best-selling model across all segments, spanning from Jan 2025 to Dec 2025.
